messages:
maria: FYI customer (ACME) hit a 400 on POST /v1/rerank, says it used to work. They pasted the exact curl they used below.

maria: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: text/plain\" \
  -d '{
    \"query\": \"recommend\",
    \"top_k\": \"3\",
    \"candidates\": [
      {\"id\": \"a\", \"text\": \"Option A\"},
      {\"id\": \"b\", \"text\": \"Option B\"},
    ],
  }'
```

maria: Server responded with 400 and this body: `{"error":"Bad Request","message":"JSON parse error: trailing comma at line 8"}`

devon: Thanks — couple notes: Content-Type is `text/plain` (should be `application/json`). Also I bet the trailing commas in the payload are the immediate parse error. And I see `top_k` sent as a string here which used to be tolerated but should be an integer.

sam: Repro'd in sandbox quickly. Sending that exact payload -> same 400. If I fix Content-Type and remove trailing commas and make `top_k` a number, it returns 200 with scores.

sam: Quick repro steps: 1) use `-H \"Content-Type: application/json\"`; 2) remove trailing commas in arrays/objects; 3) ensure `top_k` is a number (no quotes). Example working payload:
```
{
  \"query\": \"recommend\",
  \"top_k\": 3,
  \"candidates\": [
    {\"id\": \"a\", \"text\": \"Option A\"},
    {\"id\": \"b\", \"text\": \"Option B\"}
  ]
}
```

devon: Also shared logs show parser error: `JSONDecodeError: trailing comma` with correlation_id `corr-78f9` from the request.

support-bot: auto-triage: priority=high, category=client-bug-json, add-ons=escalate-eng-runtime

maria: I'll reply to the customer with the three fixes and ask them to resend with the correlation id. Escalating to eng-runtime in case we want a clearer error message (line/column).

devon: assigning to @eng-runtime, will follow up and consider returning `hint` field in 400 for common parse issues.

maria: Customer confirmed they'll update client and test. Leaving ticket open until I get a clean test.
